posts.title: Linux performance troubleshooting: a quick checklist
posts.description: Why this list A server is slow, someone is waiting, and you have just logged in. It is tempting to start guessing. What I do instead is run a fixed set of commands that, in about a minute, tells me whether the problem is CPU, memory, disk or network, and where to look next. posts.description: Why Technitium DNS Server is my DNS server of choice at home. posts.title: Making a $20 Claude Code plan last: Haiku subagents and a DeepSeek side tool
posts.description: The problem I use Claude Code on the $20 per month plan. For the kind of work I do with it (Kubernetes manifests, CI pipelines, a FastAPI backend, docs) it is very good, and that is exactly the problem: I use it a lot, and the quota runs out long before the day does. Then I sit and wait for the usage window to reset. When I looked at where the usage went, most of it was not the hard part.
